WHERE w.category = 'industrial epc' AND w.completed IS NOT NULL
AND date(w.completed) <= date('2026-09-30') AND date(w.completed) >= date('2019-09-30')
WITH w.value AS value, 400000000 AS target_value
ORDER BY value DESC
WITH collect(value) AS values_list, target_value
RETURN 
CASE

  WHEN size([value IN values_list WHERE value >= 0.6 * target_value]) >= 2 THEN 'QUALIFIES'
  WHEN size([value IN values_list WHERE value >= 0.4 * target_value]) >= 3 THEN 'QUALIFIES'
  ELSE 'DOES NOT QUALIFY'
